K14 is the unique maximal strict-savings test: every FIFO16-plus-current-Kd span for 1 <= d <= 14 is nested inside it.

unique_primary.name: dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_plus_current_k14_maximal_strict_savings_span_metricwise_oracle
unique_primary.causal_rebuild: Rebuild the exact v237 frame-zero K16 cache. For each later frame, set x0=U(Q^T y) from the frozen pre-update FIFO16 cache, run fourteen unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iterations from x0, and retain all raw paired search directions p_j,A p_j in recurrence order. Score the span [U,p_1,...,p_14]. After scoring, update the causal FIFO cache using p_1,A p_1 only, exactly as v237 and v240, so every subsequent pre-update cache remains identical to the sealed parent sequence.
unique_primary.reachable_span: All fields Uc + sum_{j=1}^{14} beta_j p_j reachable through arbitrary coefficients in the frozen pre-update FIFO16 cache and fourteen current-frame PCGLS directions. The K14 span contains every same-cache Kd span for 1 <= d <= 14.
unique_primary.maximal_strict_savings_proof: A nonzero initializer costs one A before refinement. Kd therefore costs (d+1) A and d A-transpose on each later frame. d=14 costs 15A+14A-transpose, both strictly below the 16A+16A-transpose reference. d=15 would cost 16A+15A-transpose and is not strictly lower in A, so K14 is the unique maximal depth under the frozen componentwise-strict call criterion.

metricwise_designs.field_relative_l2: mean-center every field-basis column and the truth field, then minimize Euclidean residual
metricwise_designs.gradient_relative_l2: apply the frozen physical np.gradient discretization and spacings to every field-basis column and truth, then minimize Euclidean residual over all gradient entries
metricwise_designs.interior_gradient_relative_l2: use the same gradient arrays restricted to two cells from every field boundary, then minimize Euclidean residual
metricwise_designs.observation_relative_l2: use the exact paired projected cache Q and all fourteen exact A p_j columns, then minimize residual to the current observation

unique_primary.formal_minimum_solver: NumPy reduced singular-value decomposition with retained singular values s > eps*max(rows,columns)*s_max; reconstruct the residual explicitly before normalization
unique_primary.independent_minimum_solver: an independently rebuilt cache and PCGLS recurrence followed by SciPy column-pivoted economic QR, retaining diagonal magnitudes above eps*max(rows,columns)*max(abs(diag(R))) and reconstructing the residual explicitly
unique_primary.rank_rule: Rank deficiency is a scientific property. Formal and independent numerical ranks must agree for all 533 cells and four metric images.
unique_primary.frame_zero_rule: Frame zero is fixed to the sealed K16 reference metrics and contributes ratio one to complete-rig tails.
unique_primary.interpretation_boundary: The four minima may use four different coefficient vectors. A pass establishes necessary span capacity only, not a jointly feasible field or deployment-visible coefficient rule.

sealed_control.name: v240_fifo16_plus_current_k1_subspan
sealed_control.rule: Recompute the first-direction subspan [U,p_1] inside v241 and require every minimum metric and numerical rank to reproduce the sealed v240 arrays within the frozen tolerance. It is a parent-rebuild control, not a second primary.
sealed_control.nesting_rule: Every recomputed K14 metric minimum must be no larger than its K1 control minimum up to 1e-10.

accuracy_contract.necessary_cell_rule: For every later cell and every metric, the K14 metric-specific minimum must satisfy both its absolute cell limit and 1.05 times the sealed K16 metric.
accuracy_contract.necessary_complete_rig_rule: Combine the fixed frame-zero K16 metric with the 41 later K14 metric-specific minima. Every metric's absolute and K16-relative p90-higher and worst lower bounds must satisfy the frozen complete-rig limits.

decision_order: Any parent, source, payload, operator, preconditioner, cache, direction-projection, exact-call, finite-array, rank-agreement, K1-parent-control, nesting, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v241 INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_MAXIMAL_STRICT_SAVINGS_SPAN_CAPACITY_V241.

If any later cell has a K14 metric-specific minimum above either its frozen absolute or matched cell threshold, or any complete-rig metric lower-bound tail exceeds its frozen absolute or matched threshold, conclude FAIL_CASE7_ALL_STRICT_SAVINGS_CAUSAL_CURRENT_KRYLOV_SPANS_V241. Because every same-cache K1-through-K14 span is nested inside the tested K14 span, this closes the complete frozen recycling family that keeps both A and A-transpose sequence counts strictly below K16.

Only if every one of 533 later cells and all 13 complete-rig metric lower-bound tails pass may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_MAXIMAL_STRICT_SAVINGS_SPAN_NECESSARY_HEADROOM_V241. This is necessary but not sufficient; the next result-before-run gate must test the actual unchanged K14 PCGLS coefficients and equal-or-cheaper controls.
